title: Tracks in the Snow
summary: Fresh tracks cross the path, but one set walks backward.

title: Weak Ice
summary: Snow hides a thin ice shelf.

title: Frost Herbs
summary: A blue herb cluster grows where sunlight breaks the canopy.

title: Hungry Howl
summary: A long howl rolls through the trees.

title: Buried Cache
summary: A frozen knot of rope leads to a buried trapper's cache.

title: Lost Lantern
summary: A frostbitten traveler wanders the trees, missing a lantern.

title: Wolf Pup
summary: A pup follows the party. Mother is somewhere nearby.

title: Bowy's Old Target
summary: An arrow with familiar fletching is buried in a trunk. Bowy did not fire it.

title: Garr's Old Map Stone
summary: A flat stone is scored with a route Garr used in another life. The end of the route is scratched out.

title: Frost That Listens
summary: Mitia feels the snow lean toward her like it wants to be told something.

title: Sudden Storm
summary: Wind picks up. Visibility collapses.

title: Glow Through the Pines
summary: A faint amber glow pulses through the trees in the direction of an unmarked shrine.

title: Hunter's Lost Recipe
summary: A wax-paper folded recipe sits inside a hollow log, half-frozen.

title: Rival Hunters' Camp
summary: A small camp belongs to a rival hunting band. They are not here. Their gear is.

title: Dropped Blade
summary: A short blade lies half-buried near broken snow. Someone struggled here.

title: Quick Loot
summary: The party rummages through the dead's effects.

title: Lingering Wounds
summary: The fight took more out of the party than expected.

title: Battlefield Kit
summary: An enemy carried a small medical roll.

title: Witness in the Trees
summary: A traveler watched the fight from cover. They want a word.

title: Morale Surge
summary: The cleanly-won fight steadies the whole party.

title: Worthy Trophy
summary: One body has a marked sigil. A guildmaster will pay for proof.

title: Cracked Blade
summary: Someone's weapon took the hit instead of them. It needs reforging.

title: Tally on the Quiver
summary: Bowy's quiver has more notches than he remembers carving.

title: Garr Goes Silent
summary: Garr cleans his blade longer than the wound deserves.

title: Frost Residue
summary: Frost lingers on Mitia's hands long after the fight ends.

title: Strange Coin
summary: One enemy carried a coin that does not match any kingdom's mint.

title: Half-Burnt Letter
summary: A blackened scrap of letter survives in a glove. A name is half-readable.

title: Kind Trader
summary: A road trader offers a small favor if the party shares news from the south.

title: Bad Weather
summary: Freezing wind slows travel and drains morale.

title: Forgotten Cache
summary: A hidden cache sits under a loose stone.

title: Tavern Rumor
summary: A drunk regular mutters about lights moving inside the old shrine.

title: Courier Request
summary: A travelling courier asks the party to deliver a thin wax-sealed letter on their next route.

title: Stalled Caravan
summary: Two merchant guards block the road over a weighing dispute. They want a third party to call it.

title: An Old Friend
summary: Someone from before Bin's missing year recognises him by his walk and won't let him refuse a drink.

title: Whisper Under the Bell
summary: Mitia hears a whisper inside the temple bell that no one else does. The bell rings only for her.

title: Garr's Old Mark
summary: A weathered post bears a hunter's mark Garr left years ago. The mark has been carved over.

title: Bowy's First Bow
summary: A pawnbroker shows Bowy a child's hunting bow with his initials scratched inside.

title: Plot Seed: A New Face
summary: A courier with a half-finished tattoo waits exactly where the party will pass. They have read the room before sitting down.

title: Plot Seed: Smith Without a Forge
summary: Hilda introduces a smith who lost their forge and is sleeping behind the alley. They ask for a small job.

title: Plot Seed: A Relic in the Snow
summary: A wax-wrapped object pokes out of fresh snow. Cold, heavy, a little wrong.

title: Plot Seed: A Weapon With a Name
summary: An old weapon, signed in a smith's mark no one in town recognises.

title: Plot Seed: A Whispered Line
summary: A fevered patient repeats a single line that none of the local clergy can place.

title: Plot Seed: A Letter to Someone Here
summary: A sealed letter is addressed to one of the party. The handwriting is old.

title: Plot Seed: A Choice That Stays
summary: The party is offered an easy out that costs someone a little of who they were.

title: Plot Seed: A Third Faction
summary: A messenger from a faction nobody tracks waits in the corner of the tavern.

title: Plot Seed: A Door That Was Not There
summary: A door appears in a wall the party walked past yesterday.

title: Plot Seed: A Year Bin Cannot Account For
summary: Someone produces a contract in Bin's handwriting from a city Bin has never visited.

title: Plot Seed: An Unfinished Conversation
summary: Two party members realise they were both there, on different sides, of an event neither has talked about.

title: Pickpocket Brush
summary: A child in a thin coat bumps the lead member and is gone before anyone reacts.

title: Bribe Offered
summary: A nervous clerk slides a small purse across a desk in exchange for looking the other way.

title: Loose Grate
summary: A rusted grate gives way underfoot.

title: Lost Coin Pouch
summary: A small pouch wedged between cobbles. Someone dropped it.

title: Phosphor Drip
summary: Glowing goo drips from the ceiling. Someone bottles it.

title: Kind Innkeeper
summary: A weathered innkeeper waves the party to the back kitchen and ladles hot stew.

title: Market Argument
summary: Two stalls are screaming about a stolen scale. Both want the party to weigh in.

title: Rooftop Runner
summary: A figure leaps roof to roof above the party, trailing snow.

title: Temple Question
summary: A novice asks the party an awkward theological question about miracles in wartime.

title: Back-Alley Smith
summary: A smith offers to engrave a name into a blade for cheap. The smith asks who hurt the bearer.

title: Someone Wearing Bin's Face
summary: Half a dozen witnesses swear they saw Bin in another part of town an hour ago.

title: Corvin's Paperwork
summary: Corvin needs three signatures and at least one witness to confirm Bin is alive enough to sign for jobs.
